question: How long does Manitoba health coverage generally continue after I permanently move to another Canadian province?
generated_answer:
You are covered by Manitoba Health Insurance until you establish residency in another province. In general, this means that you will be covered for at least 3 months after you move. If you are still receiving Manitoba Health coverage after 3 months, you should contact the health insurance department of the province where you moved to, to determine when your coverage will begin.

Please note that some provinces have specific rules and requirements for establishing residency and obtaining health insurance. It is best to contact the health insurance department of the province where you moved to, to confirm when your coverage will begin and to determine any specific requirements you need to meet.

It is also important to note that if you move to another country, your Manitoba Health coverage will generally end on the day you leave Manitoba. You may need to obtain private health insurance to cover you while you are outside of Canada.

If you have questions or concerns about your health coverage after moving to another province, you should contact Manitoba Health or the health insurance department of the province where you moved to for more information.
